description: Instrumental music bed, 5-60 seconds, as an asynchronous job. Describe mood, tempo and instruments, not artists or songs. May be switched off on this deployment (it then says so and offers stock music). The first call is a free price quote in credits; nothing is charged until you confirm. Show the user the credits and ask before calling again with confirm: true and the confirmationToken, then poll creative_job_status every 10-20 s. No real people's likeness or voice, no copyrighted music, logos or characters. Use when the user needs background music for a video.

confirm.description: Set true only once the user has agreed to the quoted credits.

name: creative_music

confirmationToken.description: Pass this back with confirm: true to start the job.

quote.description: First call: what generating will cost. Nothing was generated or charged yet.

refused.description: not_enabled when music generation is switched off for this account.

title: Create Music Bed
